title: Restore the exact current Case selection after server-authorized Queue Workspace return
goal: Complete CAP-INV-101 §25 by re-selecting the returned Case only after a fresh authorized Queue GET confirms exact membership on the current filtered page and a second, independent first-party Inspector GET authorizes that Case; never resurrect old rows on any failed or stale step.
invariants: CAP-INV-101 §25 filtered return restores current authorized page, filters, scroll AND selected Case; original Workspace handoff+return token never grants authority.

After first-party POST /case-queue/return, a NEW server-auth GET page must contain the exact opaque Case ID and a second NEW GET inspect_case must independently authorize its source before rendering any selected detail.
Filtered page, current Applied search and cursor are unchanged; no tenant/permission/Shared view token from browser; no Case mutation, no actual hosted Workspace or cloned Shared Inspector.
Absent Case, denied Inspector or invalid/revoked concurrent navigation must discard existing sensitive Queue/selected details without partial success.
security_properties: Use the existing first-party Case/Incident/Finding source authorization for each GET and POST; selection only from reauthorized current filtered page, never the old row or return token.
Fail-closed if currently returned Case absent from fresh page, independently denied/mismatched at Inspector, or request stale; discard earlier sensitive content.
Token remains transient JS memory, no bearer or return token in URL/storage and no new IAM/CSRF backend assumptions.

migration.rationale: Opt-in same-origin host-mounted static browser with no changed persistence or Case schema

rollback.strategy: Disable opt-in workspace handoff buttons and retain previous browser GET filter/list/Inspector; backend first-party J/K/N unchanged
verification: Existing native authorized Queue and Inspector flows remain available
No return token or Case data persisted

inputs: Canonical CAP-INV-101 §25 requires preserved view, filters, scroll and selected Case; parent T restores only view/filter/page/scroll after a server POST and fresh GET.
Existing browser Inspect action already sends an independent read-only GET /case-queue?inspect_case with current applied projection and current cursor; no new server method is required.
Parent #151 frozen HEAD e3e35e9d8e0fb1f3ba8378c9c24d3b2ee1fc9e99 with completed successful engineering-kernel run 39323528195, but native merge/reviews remain separate.
outputs: After verified POST return, fetch current owner-authorized Queue page and require exact Case ID on that page; if absent clear old display.
Reinvoke existing independently authorized Inspector GET with that ID under current applied filter/sort and cursor, then restore scroll only after current Case selection is freshly authorized.
Node browser integration tests include successful end-to-end restore plus missing Case on returned page and revoked Inspector, without old data or tokens.
acceptance_tests: Node DOM actual browser.js tests show POST return -> fresh current Queue GET -> a second authorized GET inspect_case=exact opaque ID; only then restore selected detail, focus and scroll.
Denied/missing Case after page read and denied Inspector after successful page read both wipe private page/selection, no partial output; existing Workspace/filter/XSS/Inspector tests pass.
Exact GitHub HEAD engineering-kernel CHK-CASE-QUEUE-CONTRACT, CHK-MANIFESTS and mandatory CHK-SECURITY-TESTS >=90% changed-critical unchanged; no production acceptance inferred.

performance_budget.rationale: Only one extra bounded server-authorized read-only Inspector GET on successful Case Workspace return, reusing existing Queue provider and auth; no new index, provider or persistent token.
metrics: One existing GET handoff, one POST return, one fresh GET page, one fresh GET Inspector on successful restore
At most 25 candidates on current page of <=5000 owner records per request

Existing first-party Inspector endpoint reauthorizes exact current Case from same filtered page, so no new permission authority, storage decision or OPEN-013 mutation is needed.
definition_of_done: Publish a bounded actual browser selection restore and adversarial tests; exact HEAD green GitHub Actions and immutable parent #151 evidence.
One independent READ-ONLY L2 for the material GET/POST/GET/GET trust boundary only, without duplicating #151 L2 or promoting full CAP-INV-101/Workspace to accepted.
